visual_action: The video starts with Donald Trump speaking at a podium with the Seal of the President of the United States. It then cuts to a montage of a rodeo event. Scenes include performers on horseback doing rope tricks, women carrying flags while riding, and men riding bucking horses. One shot shows the US Capitol in the background. The montage also includes shots of the crowd watching and a brief clip of Donald Trump wearing a white cowboy hat while looking at a book.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking at a podium at the beginning of the video and his speech provides the narration for the clip. He is also briefly shown in a separate clip wearing a cowboy hat.

on_screen_text.text: I DON'T KNOW HOW THEY DO IT.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces plans for an event that will include "special performances, patriotic music, high-tech demonstrations, unique exhibitions, a FIFA fan zone... and even an old-fashioned rodeo." He then expresses his personal fondness for rodeos, saying "I love rodeo. I don't know how they do it."
audio_music: The video begins with Donald Trump's speech, with no significant music. At around the 18-second mark, as the rodeo montage begins, the audio abruptly switches to the upbeat country/hip-hop song "Old Town Road" by Lil Nas X, which plays for the remainder of the video to create a high-energy, celebratory mood.
editing_pacing: The video begins with a static shot of a speech and then transitions into a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various scenes of a rodeo.
cultural_references: Old Town Road - Remix by Lil Nas X, Billy Ray Cyrus

central_claim: The White House is promoting a large-scale, patriotic 250th-anniversary celebration that will feature a variety of entertainment, including a traditional American rodeo.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and positive anticipation for the White House's 250th-anniversary event, portraying it as a fun and patriotic celebration that blends traditional and modern American culture.
